On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. blocks.text: Jared's take on Oxford Heights

Along the Coast Meridian corridor below Coquitlam’s Burke Mountain, Oxford Heights is an established pocket on Port Coquitlam’s north side. It’s mostly detached homes with some townhomes, many backing onto greenbelt and creek trails, and the north-side secondary is Terry Fox. Families who want a peaceful setting near trails feel at home here.
Oxford Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

24 houses sold in Oxford Heights with a median price of $1,269,000 (the middle half sold between $1,126,250 and $1,399,250), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $590 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 6,639 square feet.
